selection.pool: A nation's best 26 players of the era, each at his best version inside its years (highest overall; ties: the later year); 3 goalkeepers and at least 7 defenders, 7 midfielders and 4 forwards where the nation has them; no minimum rating
selection.today: The USA/Canada/Mexico 26 era: FC 24, FC 25, FC 26 and today's catalog — a catalog player is in it as he is unless one of those versions shows more
selection.spinnable: A nation that played the era's World Cup finals, or has a player shown 85+ in the era — with whatever players it has; and of the others — a pool of at least 14 players, 3 defenders, 4 midfielders (a forward beyond the first 4 counts as one) and 2 forwards, with or without a goalkeeper — those among the era's 70 strongest (mean overall of the best XI; without a keeper the era's weakest first-choice keeper stands in, an empty place counts 60)
selection.starters: A World Cup starter of the reviewed list (data/world-cup-starters.json) or a player with a breakout-lag correction is in his nation's pool of that era: he takes the place of the lowest-rated player (a keeper a keeper’s; an outfielder the lowest-rated outfielder’s whose line keeps its minimum)
selection.best: Everyone in a pool also has his best version of all titles in the file (the Prime), in a pool or not
